description: This file defines the WebHookProcessor class, which implements the HookProcessor interface. It handles processing of webhooks by extracting configuration, preparing request data, and sending HTTP requests (JSON or form-based) to external URLs based on the hook configuration.

classes.name: WebHookProcessor
classes.description: A Spring Service class responsible for processing hooks by sending HTTP requests based on hook configurations and payloads.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes a hook by extracting URL and content type from configuration and delegating the request sending.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Helper method that sends either a JSON or form request to the specified URL using Retrofit, depending on content type.
